# A flag passed through after -- must not change which packages are tested.
#
# go test reads [flags] [packages] [flags and test binary flags]. A flag it
# does not know -- a test binary's own, like -update -- ends the package list,
# so flags placed before the packages would silently drop every package after
# the first. Here the only test that catches the mutant is in ./sub, so a
# dropped package reads as a miss.

muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
cmp stdout want-killed.txt

muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 -- -update=false
cmp stdout want-killed.txt

# Everything after -args belongs to the test binary. Only the root package is
# tested here, and its test does not look at the text, so the mutant lives --
# which it can only do if muxt's own -overlay reached go test rather than the
# test binary.
muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 . -- -args -update
cmp stdout want-root-only.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name string
}

func Greet(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", page)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"flag"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

var update = flag.Bool("update", false, "rewrite golden files")

func TestGreetRenders(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Greet(&buf, Page{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
-- sub/sub_test.go --
package sub

import (
	"flag"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"server"
)

var update = flag.Bool("update", false, "rewrite golden files")

func TestGreetText(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := server.Greet(&buf, server.Page{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Hello, World!"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("greeting = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
